title: fix(lint,core)!: refuse a lookup dependsOn filter key naming a formula of its target; an import lookup no scoped read answered is never out of scope
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-sales"} -->
_Requested by **Sales** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu?thread=cmsg_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu1PSnWkmbF453BynqtyjJc5)_

Fixes #37717

Clause-②: yes (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: narrowed
Skills-docs: none — no `skills/` page teaches a `dependsOn` filter key on a formula field; `content/docs/data-modeling/import-mappings.mdx` names the refusal in this change

## 维护者速读

- 应用作者在查找字段的 `dependsOn` 里，把筛选键指向目标对象上的公式字段时，`os validate`、构建以及 Studio、REST、MCP 保存都会直接报错，并点出是哪个字段、为什么不行、该改成哪个存储字段。以前这种写法能发布，之后记录选择器查不出候选，导入这一列的每一行都失败。
- 这是座位复审 PR #37706 时留下的两条小尾巴（导入“值属于另一个父记录”这条提示的后续）：一条是作者时提前报错，一条是导入时如果限定范围的查询一次都没得到回答，就不再说“这个值在别的父记录下”，只说找不到记录。
- 出错会怎样：只有用到这种写法的对象下次保存时会被拒；仓库里的示例应用和打包对象、hotcrm 都没有这种写法；存量数据不改写，开机不拒。整张 PR 可以直接撤回。
- 要你做的：这是收严（narrowing），走 Tier H，等你审批。

## What changes

- **`@objectstack/lint`, N2: the `dependsOn` filter key must be filterable.** `validateObjectFieldRefs` (`validate-object-field-refs.ts`) gains a `filtered` flag on its field-name slots, set on the REFERENCE half of `dependsOn` (`param`, else the bare name or `field`), the key the record picker's candidate query and the importer's scoped lookup filter the referenced object by. When that name resolves to an authored field of the referenced object that is computed on read (`isVirtualSearchField` from `@objectstack/spec/data`, the predicate the engine's filter seam and the import resolver already use), it reports at `error`, under the existing rule id `object-field-ref-unknown`, at the entry's path. It runs wherever that rule runs: `os validate` / `lint` / `compile` / `build` and the runtime publish gate for `object` writes. Example finding:
  ```text
  fields.contact.dependsOn[0].param "account_label" is a formula field of "showcase_contact", computed on read: no record-picker query or import lookup can filter on it.
  ```
  The hint names the fix: point the entry at a stored field of the referenced object that holds the same value, in the `{ field, param }` form, or drop it. A formula on the OWNING side (`dependsOn[i].field`, the form's gate, read from the record being edited) stays legal. `os explain object-field-ref-unknown` (`rule-explanations.ts`) gains one sentence for it; the module note says what is judged and why.
- **`@objectstack/core`, N4: no unscoped probe when no scoped read answered.** The import resolver (`import-runner.ts`) now marks every scoped lookup none of whose candidate reads answered, and the field guard did not refuse, as `RefMatch.scopeUnanswered` when the refusals did not name an unfilterable scope field (that case keeps `scopeUnqueryable`). `referenceNotFound` (`import-coerce.ts`) returns the plain `reference_not_found` refusal for it before the unscoped probe. Before, an all-refused scoped lookup (for example every read refused `INVALID_FILTER` because the row's master cell is a value the scoping field's type cannot take) was asked again without the scope and could answer `reference_out_of_scope`, a claim about where the value lives that the import never checked. `RefMatch` gains the optional member `scopeUnanswered`.
- **Wording (N4).** The `validation-message.ts` jsdoc on `import_reference_scope_unqueryable` and the `import-mappings.mdx` paragraph now say that any other all-refused scoped lookup keeps `reference_not_found` and the plain sentence and is not tried again without the scope. The docs paragraph also says the formula case is refused at authoring now.
- **Upgrade guide.** New ADR-0087 semantic entry `lookup-depends-on-param-computed-field-refused` (`packages/spec/src/migrations/entries/semantic/`), notice only: no D2 conversion, since only the author knows which stored field carries the value the formula computes.
- **Changeset** `.changeset/37717-lookup-depends-on-param-computed-field.md`: `@objectstack/lint` minor (the narrowing), `@objectstack/core` and `@objectstack/spec` patch, BREAKING banner, FROM → TO, `registered` disposition. The pending note `.changeset/36794-wizard-reference-out-of-scope.md` is left as it is: its sentence "A scoped lookup whose reads are all refused for any other reason (no read access to the target, say) keeps the plain `no record matches` sentence." was loose on `main` (review N4) and is exactly true after this change, so it is not rewritten.

### Small choices made here (dev's call, per the claim)

- One rule id, `object-field-ref-unknown`, not a new one. The roll-up filter position in the same rule already refuses a key computed on read under that id, and the rule already runs at error on every door this needs, so no new registration, explanation entry or door wiring was added.
- Population: fields computed on read only (`SEARCH_VIRTUAL_TYPES`, today `formula`), which is what the card names. A `secret` / `password` field, or one flagged `internal: true`, is also refused as a filter key for a non-system caller, but by a guard that judges the caller, not the field's storage; left out (see Acceptance notes).
- N4 covers every all-refused scoped lookup, not only `INVALID_FILTER`: whatever refused every scoped read, the scope was never asked, so a hit without it says nothing about the scope.

## Tests

- `packages/lint/src/validate-object-field-refs.test.ts`, in the `dependsOn` describe: a `param` naming a formula of the referenced object is refused at `.param` with the field and the reason; a bare name that is a formula on the referenced side is refused at the entry; a stored `param`, and a formula on the owning side only, pass; the runtime publish gate refuses it too (`objects.crm_invoice.fields.contact.dependsOn[0].param`). The file's own 200-character cap on every fired verdict still holds.
- `packages/core/src/utils/import-runner-reference-master-scope.test.ts`: every scoped read refused `INVALID_FILTER` while the unscoped read would answer with a record under another project; the cell answers `reference_not_found`, the plain sentence, no `scope`, and every read of the target carried the scope (no unscoped probe).
- Ablations (tree `40007bc2`, through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, each restored to the `HEAD` blob with `git diff HEAD` empty):
  - runner: `{ scopeUnanswered: true }` → `{}`: the N4 pin goes red (`reference_out_of_scope` received), 1 failed / 19 passed; restored 20 passed.
  - coerce: the `scopeUnanswered` early return deleted: the same pin red, 1 failed / 19 passed.
  - lint: the `filtered` branch disabled: 3 failed / 128 passed (the two refusals and the runtime-gate pin); restored 131 passed.

## Acceptance notes

- First-party exposure, measured: `objectstack validate` passes on all five example apps (`app-crm`, `app-showcase`, `app-starter`, `app-todo`, `app-multi-package`) with the new rule built in. Positive control on the same CLI: adding a formula `account_label` to `showcase_contact` and pointing `showcase_invoice.contact`'s `dependsOn` `param` at it exits 1 with the finding quoted above (both mutations restored). By reading, every other shipped `dependsOn` is clean: the five in `plugin-sharing` sit on `text` / non-picker fields, where the filter half has no reader and is not judged; every one in hotcrm (`crm_account`, `crm_project`) names a `lookup` / `master_detail` field of its target.
- Not judged here, for a later card if anyone wants it: a `dependsOn` filter key naming a `secret` / `password` field or an `internal: true` field. Those are refused as filters for non-system callers by the credential and internal-field guards, a judgment about the caller, not about the field's storage.
- A stored object that already carries such an entry is not refused at boot. Its import keeps the could-not-look-up sentence from #37706, and its next publish is refused.

## Verification

Read first: the `filtered` branch in `validateObjectFieldRefs` (`validate-object-field-refs.ts`), the all-refused branch at the end of the resolver's `lookup` (`import-runner.ts`), and the `scopeUnanswered` return in `referenceNotFound` (`import-coerce.ts`).

Two-minute check: `pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint exec vitest run src/validate-object-field-refs.test.ts -t "formula"` runs 3 tests, all green.

Three exit 3, prerequisite not met, NOT measured: `check-plugin-teardown-shape --self-test` (shallow clone), `spec check:skill-examples` (client-react not built), `check:dual-build-cjs-loads`; CI covers these families on this head. `check:type-check-debt` first queued behind the dogfood hold, then re-run under the lock: exit 0, 0 ledger entries above their number.
- Dogfood battery on 40007bc2 under `os-verify-lock`: VERDICT command-exit 0, Test Files 490 passed / 3 skipped (493), Tests 4144 passed / 68 skipped (4212), no failures.
- CI on 40007bc2: 60 check-runs success, 10 skipped, none failed.

## Human Minimum

- [x] 1. Schemas start as Zod; `packages/spec` holds no runtime logic.
- [x] 2. Every name I added uses the casing for its kind.
- [x] 3. No formatter ran; `pnpm lint` passes.
- [x] 4. One issue, one branch off an up-to-date `main`, one pull request.
- [x] 5. A change that publishes carries a changeset, and both declaration lines are filled in here and in the changeset.
- [x] 6. `packages/spec` touched: its generated artifacts are regenerated and committed.
- [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`.
- [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English.
